description: This file defines data structures and parsing logic for handling deep links within an 'OpenClaw' application, including routes for agents and gateways, parsing URLs, and constructing connection details.

methods.name: fromSetupCode
methods.description: Parses a base64url-encoded JSON setup code to create a GatewayConnectDeepLink object.

methods.name: decodeBase64Url
methods.description: Decodes a base64url-encoded string into Data.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a URL into a DeepLinkRoute, recognizing agent and gateway schemes.
